subject: index_boundary
choice: Use existing snapshot_collection before build and after every real-index smoke is finished.
reason: Compare IDs/documents/canonical metadata/float32 embeddings; physical housekeeping is outside the logical equality boundary.

subject: verification
choice: Run all requested regression selections and full suite under the image Linux/Python3.12 dependencies.
reason: The Windows project venv targets a missing interpreter; a separate managed Python3.11.15 shim was discovered later. Linux verification is intentionally kept independent of that venv. Test-only dependencies and source mounts do not change the production image.

subject: cleanup
choice: Stop/remove only named smoke containers and their dedicated networks; retain built image and evidence.
reason: No user containers existed initially; no global Docker prune or destructive repository cleanup.

subject: temporary_cleanup_complete
choice: Remove only the recorded /var/tmp workspace, owned marker directory and auxiliary test-tools image; retain primary build image and evidence.
reason: All verification has finished; SQLite/observations captured, no user data or existing hello-world image removed. No Docker/global filesystem prune.

subject: review_real_provider_boundary
reason: Explicit operational scope prefers no external calls. Cost if treated as production proof: remote/model behavior would remain unvalidated.
choice: Retain controlled provider only; real connectivity/credentials, dense embedding API and legal answer quality remain unexecuted.

subject: review_observation_boundary
reason: No universal packet or cryptographic secret scan performed. Cost of overclaiming: uninstrumented traffic/files would be unproven.
choice: Keep bounded claims for Python socket/DNS/httpx guards and inspected application-file paths.

subject: review_production_boundary
reason: Explicit user constraints; production-backend/readiness claims would otherwise be unsupported.
choice: No production deployment, new auth, live PostgreSQL/Mongo or legacy provider invocation.

subject: review_physical_index_boundary
reason: No physical ownership baseline was captured before first mount; retroactive claims would be unsupported.
choice: Report current normal-user access and logical equality only, with no historical ACL/physical-housekeeping equality claim.
